_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt on the ten Mobbin captures in assets/refs: 1180x2676 sRGB, an iPhone 15/16 screen at 3 px/pt (1179x2556 for 393x852) plus Mobbin's own 120px attribution bar under it, so run with --pt 3 and expect the far right edge to sit one capture pixel inside the box. --against wants scratch/mine, the renders from `refkit shoot --scale 3 --crop-phone` resized 1179->1180 with LANCZOS, one file per `mine`. A sample probe on ink carries --only ink, because batch reads the first colour a probe prints; `bright: true` there means the ink is lighter than its ground. On a bbox, `dark`/`bright` is the luminance threshold that counts as ink. The status bar and home indicator come from the template rather than the capture, so no probe sits above y 54 - the one home-indicator sample is a known near-match, noted in the README.
